ray.name: Light Ray
ray.telegraph: A narrow luminous ray begins to form.
ray.description: A fast, near-guaranteed bolt. Deadly to anything left on the targeted tile — but it commits early, so a read can be dodged.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.description: A quick one-tile reposition. Cheap and fast — your bread-and-butter reaction to a telegraphed attack.

stride.name: Stride
stride.description: Cover more ground, but a longer path is easier for an opponent to predict and cut off.

shield.name: Ward
shield.description: Raise a directional ward toward a chosen tile. Absorbs one hit from that side — useless against an attack from your flank.

rune.name: Snare Rune
rune.description: Set a rune on a tile. It triggers on whoever steps onto it — punishing a predictable dodge.

burst.name: Flame Burst
burst.description: A slow area blast. Covers several escape tiles at once, so a simple dodge may not be enough — but it is expensive and easy to see coming.

wait.name: Hold
wait.description: Bide a tick, watching. Costs nothing and lets readiness recover while you wait for the enemy to commit.
